_comment: Every Dart (non-Flutter) workspace package that `_test-dart` and
`_coverage-dart` run. `daemon` holds most of the suites and gets a shard
to itself so the slot allocator can hand it the whole machine; the rest
share one. The list lives here rather than inline so the test shard, the
coverage shard, and coverage-check cannot drift apart, and so a package
added here joins a shard instead of silently going untested.
